summary: Full validation of Info Sheet #12: Knowledge Search + Pro-Referral hand-off. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests pass covering GET /api/knowledge/search (grouped results across guide/community/tip/question, AI query-expansion via gpt-4o-mini populates related[], short/nonsense queries return zero results safely, expand=false skips LLM, auth required), GET /api/pro-referrals/trades (returns 8 trades incl. Plumbing/Electrical/HVAC), POST /api/pro-referrals (persists lead, invalid urgency coerced to 'standard', requires auth, verifiable via /pro-referrals/me), GET /api/admin/pro-leads (admin gated: 403 for standard user), PATCH /api/admin/pro-leads/{id} (status transitions persist, invalid status → 400). Frontend (Expo web): (1) User flow — /(tabs)/community → tap testID community-search-bar navigates to /search; search-input loads with autofocus, popular chips render (search-suggest-Leaky faucet etc.). Typing 'leaky faucet' + Enter returns 5 results grouped by type (Guide, Community, Tip, Q&A) rendered as search-result-{i} cards with type icons + snippets + author byline where applicable; 4 AI 'RELATED SEARCHES' chips render (search-related-*) and tapping one re-runs the search with the chosen term. Nonsense query 'zxzxzxqqppqqzzzz' returns 0 results and shows 'Nothing matched — get unstuck' escalation block with search-ask-community and search-get-pro. Popular chip 'Paint a room' re-runs search returning 7 results. Result card tap navigates to /blog/replace-a-kitchen-faucet-moen-adler-87233. search-ask-community navigates to /community. (2) ProReferralModal — all form testIDs present and interactive: pro-trade-Electrical, pro-issue, pro-location, pro-urgency-standard, pro-submit; after submit success screen 'Request received' renders with pro-done. (3) Admin — /auth login as Diyhomieapp@gmail.com → /admin → admin-nav-proleads renders 'Pro Referral Leads' page with headline count ('4 total · 3 new · escalated jobs above DIY.'), 5 filter chips (proleads-filter-{all,new,contacted,matched,closed}), leads list showing trade badge / issue / urgency badge / contact name+email / location, 4 status chips per lead (proleads-{id}-{status}); clicking a status chip optimistically updates UI and PATCHes backend; filter chips correctly narrow list. Search AI expansion latency ~2-4s; 30s timeout is generous. No deprecated packages (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch) in new files. Minor cosmetic: MaterialCommunityIcons warnings for invalid icon names 'deck' and 'sink' (pre-existing seed data, not from this iteration).
action_items: (Optional / cosmetic) Pre-existing warning noise: MaterialCommunityIcons complains that 'deck' and 'sink' are not valid icon names — these come from seeded community/project category icons, not new code. Consider mapping to valid icons (e.g. 'deck-outline' does not exist — 'floor-plan' or 'home-outline' as fallback; 'sink' → 'faucet' or 'water-pump'). Not from this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1361 _kw_regex correctly filters STOP_WORDS + short tokens (<3 chars) before regex OR-join; falls back to raw query if terms empty.
server.py:1368 _expand_query wraps _llm_json in try/except and always returns a safe {related:[], did_you_mean:None} default → search never fails due to LLM.
server.py:1382 knowledge_search: short-query guard (len<2) returns cleanly with empty payload. Auth-gated via Depends(get_current_user).
server.py:1388-1397 4 collection searches with proper $or filters and (_id:0) projection — no MongoDB ObjectId leakage. Reasonable limits (20/10/15/10).
server.py:1422 create_pro_lead validates urgency enum on the server side (coerces bad values to 'standard') — matches Pydantic model default.
server.py:1442 admin_pro_leads correctly uses require_admin dep; returns {items:[]} shape matching ProLeadsModule expectations.
server.py:1452 admin_update_pro_lead validates status enum before UPDATE, returns 400 on invalid — matches test suite expectation.
search.tsx uses 30s timeout on the /knowledge/search call which is appropriate given the ~2-4s AI expansion latency.
ProReferralModal disables submit until trade selected AND issue.trim().length >= 5 — good UX guard mirrored server-side.
ProLeadsModule uses optimistic UI update on setStatus with load() fallback on PATCH error — resilient.
All 3 new components use React Native primitives (View/Text/Pressable/TextInput/ScrollView/Modal/KeyboardAvoidingView), StyleSheet.create, and MaterialCommunityIcons only — no HTML tags, no expo-av.
